_source: Hand-verified from BHP Group 2021 Preliminary Final Report (ASX: 2021-08-17) via docling cache (98 tables, 82 pages). All values USD millions. Scale=millions confirmed from page 44 consolidated income statement header. CF/BS/shares verified from docling tables 4, 8, 12, 45, 46, 57, 76.

notes.revenue: Confirmed from page 44: 'Revenue 60,817' USD millions. Source: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income.
notes.ebit: Row label 'Profit from operations' = 25,906 USD millions (page 44). BHP uses this label for EBIT. Cross-check: PBT approx 26,600 less net finance costs ~700 = 25,906.
notes.np_attributable: Row 'Profit attributable to BHP shareholders' = 11,304 USD millions (page 44 or nearby). Includes minority deduction.
notes.operating_cf: Table 46 (Consolidated Cash Flow Statement): 'Net operating cash flows' = 27,234 USD millions (from continuing operations = 27,234; discontinued = 0). Cross-check: Table 4 highlights confirms 'Net operating cash flow = 27,234'.
notes.investing_cf: Table 46: 'Net investing cash flows' = (7,845) USD millions. Confirmed from continuing ops (7,845) + discontinued (0). Cross-check: Table 74 'Net investing cash flows = (7,845)' and Table 76 net debt reconciliation.
notes.financing_cf: Table 46: 'Net financing cash flows' = (17,922) USD millions. Major components: repayment of interest bearing liabilities (8,395), dividends paid (7,901), NCI dividends (2,127).
notes.cash_end: Table 46: 'Cash and cash equivalents, net of overdrafts, at the end of the financial year' = 15,246 USD millions. Cross-check: Table 45 balance sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents = 15,246'. Arithmetic: 13,426 (start) + 1,467 (net change from ops) + 353 (FX) = 15,246.
notes.capex: Table 4 highlights: 'Capital and exploration expenditure = 7,120' USD millions. Table 46 detail: PP&E purchases (6,606) + exploration (514) = 7,120. Note: exploration expensed-in-ops (430) not netted.
notes.net_debt: Table 4 highlights: 'Net debt = 4,121' USD millions. Table 8 net debt bridge: opening 12,044 - free cash flow 19,389 + dividends 7,901 + NCI dividends 2,127 + other 359 = 4,121. Table 76 confirms same figure. BHP defines net debt as: interest bearing liabilities - index-linked freight - cash - net swaps - net cash mgmt instruments (Table 84).
notes.shares_outstanding: Table 12: 'Weighted basic average number of shares (million) = 5,057'. Table 57 EPS note confirms: Basic = 5,057 million. BHP has dual-listed structure (BHP Group Limited + BHP Group Plc); this is the combined weighted average used for reporting. Actual issued shares differ (split across ASX and LSE listings).
